name: Cadet Airman chevron on cloth (1/8 in border)
size_basis: Scale 350.0 photo px per inch: the Vanguard Cadet CMSgt photo (612 px tall) is set to 1.75 in, from the requester's statement (2026-10-12) that it nearly fills the 2 in OCP square leaving about 1/8 in top and bottom; CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-5 gives no inch size. Every grade uses the same scale (the photos share one scale: 381 px chevron width).
provenance: traced from the Vanguard cadet chevron photos (images/ranks/C) at the requester's direction; chrome shading flattened by chroma classification

mounts.rule: the regulation prescribes METAL chevrons for cadet NCOs and Airmen on every uniform (see MOUNT_METAL); this cloth-bordered form was built at the requester's direction and has no authorized position (7.1.1.8 and 6.2.11.1 bar insignia on the caps). Not for use on caps.

regulation_note: Kept at the requester's direction. CAPR 39-1 prescribes METAL chevrons for cadet NCOs and Airmen on every uniform and bars all insignia for them on the OCP/ABU/tactical caps (7.1.1.8, 6.2.11.1); no cloth chevron position exists. The importer should not offer this form by default.
size_citation: border: CAPR 39-1 5.1.1.1.1.1 / 5.1.1.1.1.3 (ABU) and 7.1.1.8 (OCP/tactical cap), 1/8 in showing past the widest and tallest point

cloth_color.note: dark blue cloth; same hex as the utility-uniform rank square and tapes (make-ocp-abu.js)
